A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the combination between 75 and 150 ppm ZnSO4 and GA3, respectively, could improve vegetative and flowering characters of jojoba, and consequently, increase seed yield and oil content of the seeds.
the application of ZnSO4 and GA3 to jojoba plants could be a useful technique for improving jojoba productivity.
the application of zinc sulphate and gibberellice acid to jojoba plants could improve the growth and flowering characteristics, seed yield and quality.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the combination of ZnSO4 plus GA3 could be a good strategy to increase jojoba seed yield.
the combination of zinc and gibberelins is an efficient strategy to increase jojoba seed oil yield.
foliar application of ZnSO4 (75 ppm) and GA3 (150 ppm) is a useful method for increasing jojoba yield and its oil composition and so, raise its economic value.
